header.title: Number of deaths of notifiable infectious diseases
tablenote: Number of deaths refers to deaths registered at the Immigration Department in the period, irrespective of the date of notification to the Department of Health.  The figures are provisional and would be revised based on updated information.

'Melioidosis' has been listed as a notifiable infectious disease since 11 November 2022. The figures of 'Melioidosis' from 1 January to 10 November 2022 were based on the notifications from Hospital Authority according to the month of laboratory confirmation.
